text:
Michael Amadio has seven goals in 24 games for Ottawa, four of them in his last ten, and people have noticed. SenShot wrote that it's about time he got the recognition he deserves, and TSN's Mike Johnson says Amadio will cash in on his next contract.

There is real substance here. Evolving-Hockey had him 73rd among 401 forwards last season, in the 93rd percentile at taking chances away, and he draws more penalties than he takes. His wins added, a measure of how much his goals swung games, ranks 59th in the league. None of his points have come on the power play.

Some of the goal total will not last. He is shooting 21.9%, above the top of his talent range, and he has scored two more goals than his chances deserve. Evolving-Hockey also notes he plays with strong teammates, which flatters his raw numbers. The 2023 Cup winner from Vegas is a valuable middle-six forward. Watch how much of the scoring holds once the shooting cools.
headline: Michael Amadio is cashing in on chances and attention
